original_definition: MajoritySAT asks whether NumberSAT(phi)>2^(n-1), where n is the declared-variable count. At n=0 this is equivalent to the empty assignment satisfying phi.
current_definition: On a well-formed NumberSAT input consisting of a formula $\varphi$ and a declared list $(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$ of $n$ distinct variables, **MajoritySAT** asks whether $\mathrm{NumberSAT}(\varphi,(x_1,\ldots,x_n))>2^{n-1}$. Every malformed input is a no-instance. At $n=0$ the inequality is equivalent to the empty assignment satisfying $\varphi$.
